name: James Black
office: City of Rolling Hills, Member of the City Council

items.text: James Black is a member of the Rolling Hills City Council and a plastic surgeon. He has served on the council since 2003.

sentences.text: James Black is a member of the Rolling Hills City Council and a plastic surgeon.
He has served on the council since 2003.

items.text: He has stated that the city’s biggest needs include reducing brush and overgrowth to limit wildfire severity, undergrounding utility lines to decrease fire risk, and improving cell service. As mayor in 2022, he voted to adopt the city’s housing element for the 2021 to 2029 cycle.
